text:
Dana: Traveling to Seattle next week, staying in Ballard. Any recs for fresh seafood that also has solid vegan sides? Want one dinner for a couple of folks and a casual breakfast spot.
Ibrahim: For seafood, try The Walrus & The Carpenter (oysters)  small plates, very fresh. Theyre walkable but expect a line.
Grace: If you want a more sit-down dinner, RockCreek has great seasonal fish and lots of veg-forward choices. Good for groups of 4-6.
Tom: For casual vegan-friendly spot, check out Plum Bistro (Capitol Hill)  not Ballard but worth the 15-min ride for inventive vegan mains.
Dana: Hmm ok. Any Ballard cafes with good breakfast + GF options near the hotel?
Ibrahim: Ballard Coffee Works is solid for espresso and has GF muffins sometimes. Also 'Portage Bay Cafe' does pancakes + a build-your-own omelette and marks GF.
Grace: If you want something light, 'The Fat Hen' does great morning pastries and has dairy-free options.
Dana: Sounds great. Which of those are easiest for a Friday night group dinner (we're 5)? RockCreek vs Walrus & Carpenter?
Tom: RockCreek is more dinner-friendly for groups and accepts reservations. Walrus is more of an oyster-bar experience and walk-in.
Ibrahim: Book RockCreek for 5 at 7pm if you want guaranteed seating.
Dana: I'll book RockCreek for Fri 7pm. Thanks! Any parking tips?
Grace: Street parking is limited  rock the garage at Ballard Ave Garage or use the app 'ParkSeattle'. Also rideshares dropoff is easy on Market St.

Ibrahim: :raised_hand:

Tom: I can't make it (red-eye flight)
